search_core.reason: User-reported defect confirmed real, not a false complaint: the Homepage->/search/results transition showed a completely bare Suspense fallback (no header/brand/shared chrome at all - confirmed via raw HTTP fetch of the route's initial document) before the results component mounted, and the loaded results page's edit-search form only exposes origin/destination/vertical (dates/passengers/trip-type are preserved in state/URL but not visible/editable there). The chrome-continuity half is fixed and deployed (commit 72858e2, verified live via HTTP: the fallback now includes the same breadcrumb/brand-mark markup). The edit-form field-exposure gap is real and NOT fixed (flagged as follow-up). Full experience-level confirmation (does it still *feel* continuous to a real user, desktop+mobile, interactive) could not be completed this session - the Chrome browser extension did not connect, so no screenshots/live interaction were possible. Backend search (/search/v2, auth-gated, fail-closed, 9 routes) remains real and unaffected throughout - this downgrade is about journey/UX continuity, not backend functionality. Follow-up closed this session (commit bcb7ef9, deployed and live): the edit-search form on /search/results now parses and exposes trip_type/children/infants/cabin (previously invisible), and makes depart/return/adults/children/infants/rooms/cabin/trip_type genuinely editable (previously summary-only or entirely absent), matching Homepage's field vocabulary exactly, vertical-conditional per spec. Verified live: the new field labels (کلاس پروازی/بزرگسال/کودک/نوزاد/نوع سفر) are present in the actual deployed JS bundle served at the public URL. Still PARTIAL, not LIVE: no browser tool was available this session to confirm the felt interactive/visual experience or check mobile - that remains the one outstanding proof. Architectural fix closed this session (commit 0a88457, deployed and live): Search submit no longer navigates to a separate route - HomeSearchExperience now pushes to /?<params> (same route already mounted), and app/page.tsx renders UnifiedSearchView inline (embedded prop) directly beneath the search form once params are present, reusing the existing pathname/state-branching pattern already used elsewhere in that same file for Hotels/Compare/Assistant/etc. /search/results itself is untouched and still works standalone for deep links. Verified live: a real `next build` succeeded with / still prerendering as Static; the UnifiedSearchView code (results-breadcrumb/search-results-page markers) is now genuinely present in the homepage's served JS bundle, confirming the inline wiring shipped, not just committed. Still PARTIAL, not LIVE: no browser tool was available this session to confirm the actual felt experience (does the transition read as continuous, does the auth gate look acceptable in context, mobile) - that remains the one outstanding proof, now for the third consecutive session. EXPLICIT PRIORITY OVERRIDE (2026-08-26, user decision, not an agent judgment call): user explicitly decided search_core is GOOD_ENOUGH to stop closing for now and move to a new phase (GRS hotel provider integration). This is NOT a claim of COMPLETE - status stays PARTIAL by the registry's own enum, decision_status above records the override so it is never silently read as done. Same-session evidence since the above: a real infinite-request-loop bug was found and fixed (components/operational/UnifiedSearchView.tsx execute() useCallback listed localRecent as a dependency while also writing it on every success, recreating the callback and re-firing the effect that calls it - commit pending, deployed as karenseir-frontend-prod:7b7bf6f-fix1, verified live: request count went from 77+ and climbing to a flat 1-2 per search); a limited [TEST]-marked QA dataset (8 offers/2 suppliers, karenseir-public tenant only) was seeded and verified end-to-end (flight + hotel verticals return real RESULTS from the real API, anonymous price-hiding still correct, no fake data outside the tenant).
